metadataReview.note: Location review: the marker represents the Breymann Redoubt assault sector of the 7 October 1777 battle. It is derived from the NPS georeferenced 1777 fortification line identified as Breymann Redoubt on the official 2004 General Management Plan battle map. The GIS is explicitly schematic and has no measured positional accuracy; coordinates are rounded to three decimals as a display convention. This sector anchor does not reconstruct the wider battlefield, the opening combat at Barber Wheatfield, or individual troop positions. The existing 7 October date is retained.

metadataReview.coordinateBasis: Midpoint along feature 3 (zero-based index 2) of the public NPS redoubts.shp polyline dataset, transformed from NAD83 / UTM zone 18N (EPSG:26918) to WGS84 and rounded to three decimals. Feature identity is checked against the labeled NPS General Management Plan 2004 map, Part 2, printed p.17 (PDF p.11). The dataset describes approximate fortified lines for schematic mapping; positional accuracy was not measured. This is a fortification-sector locator, with no claimed numeric error radius.
